question: What recycling cost per kilogram does the review give for direct recycling?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%/kg%' OR text ILIKE '%per kg%' OR text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%$%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%direct recycl%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (2,6,9,10) AND (text ILIKE '%cost%' OR text ILIKE '%USD%' OR text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%economic%') ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=9 AND line_no BETWEEN 28 AND 45 ORDER BY line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (6,10) AND line_no BETWEEN 14 AND 32 ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE (text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%/kg%' OR text ILIKE '%kWh%' OR text ILIKE '%$%' OR text ILIKE '%USD%') ORDER BY page
SELECT id, figure_id, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%cost%' OR text ILIKE '%kg%' OR text ILIKE '%direct%' OR text ILIKE '%$%' OR text ILIKE '%USD%'
SELECT id, page, text FROM cells WHERE text ILIKE '%cost%' OR text ILIKE '%kg%'
SELECT id, page, caption FROM figures
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%recycling cost%' OR text ILIKE '%cost of%' OR text ILIKE '%per ton%' OR text ILIKE '%per tonne%' OR text ILIKE '%/t%' OR text ILIKE '%per metric%'
SELECT figure_id, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE figure_id IN ('p9.F5','p6.F4','p2.F1','p3.F2','p4.F3')

runs.text: The review does not give a recycling cost per kilogram for direct recycling. Its direct-recycling passages (for example the statement that life-cycle analysis and process-based cost models show economic benefits over pyrometallurgical and hydrometallurgical processes) are qualitative and carry no per-kilogram cost figure. No per-kilogram cost appears in the prose, tables, figure text or figure captions.
